best_echo_sets.commentary: Offers a 10% unconditional Aero DMG% boost and an additional 30% Aero DMG% after using the intro lasting 15 seconds for a grand total of 40% additional Aero damage for most of your damage window.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: Offers an unconditional 12% Aero DMG and Heavy ATK boost when used as the Main Echo, and additionally is a Summon-type echo making it easy to use in any character's rotation, which often makes it the best option for any character using the set.

best_echo_sets.commentary: Only use this set with Ciaccona on the team. Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Aalto and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Aalto's rotations, it is the best Main Echo he has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats!)

best_echo_sets.commentary: Offers a 10% unconditional Energy Regen% boost taking some pressure off your gear when aiming at ER breakpoints. Also upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost, amplifying any of your main damage dealers burst windows.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: Supportive Echo that can be run at the cost of a sizeable chunk of damage for the character who equips, trading personal gain for team benefits. Should always be used and immediately switch cancelled right before performing an Outro, leading to another DPS. When done so will grant the next character switching in 12% increased DMG% which when combined with the 5P Moonlit set which also grants 22.5% ATK% under the same conditions makes for a sizeable boost. While the echo does lower the damage of whoever wears it, it grants a massive chunk of energy on use usually saving 1 or sometimes even 2 Energy Regen sub stats that may otherwise be needed by the wearer allowing for some damage to be recovered.

best_weapons.commentary_details: The best weapon for most DPS Pistol characters, Carlotta's Signature is fantastic it provides lots of ATK, CRIT DMG and Skill DMG Bonus, which are good stats overall that Aalto can use well (although the Skill DMG isn't ideal, it's still acceptable).

Inherent skills that do essentially nothing;

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Aalto is a DPS character who is very unique - also playable as a Hybrid buffer, he creates misty gates that empower his attacks when he shoots through them. Able to jump through them to turn incorporeal to increase his movement speed, he can create mist clones to taunt nearby enemies and effectively endorse the role of a trickster, who can deal damage while distracting enemies to prevent himself from being interrupted as he attacks.

Able to buff Aero damage dealers via his Outro skill, he was originally perceived to work exclusively as a hybrid character. However, that is not the case — while this role is suitable for him, it is currently subpar in the meta, very much outshined in Jiyan teams by Mortefi, a hybrid who is not only stronger but featured on every banner along with Jiyan, as the heavy attack amplifier was designed with the heavy attack-focused DPS in mind.

Suffering from this constant comparison makes Aalto seem like a totally outclassed character; however, if you truly harness his damage potential and invest into him like a Main DPS, as it turns out, he is able to fully clear the tower's endgame content if you wish to master his kit.

The main part of his DPS potential is acquired through his mid-air attacks, the pistol shots that he fires after jumping into the air and pressing the attack button. Typically totaling between 8 and 10 pistol shots, those effective ranged bursts of damage, that receive buffed damage when shooting through gates generated by his Ultimate, give Aalto a niche as a Main DPS carry, while not being near the best in his role. He falls short not only from a damage standpoint, but from an energy regen standpoint, as Aalto has a hefty 150 energy cost on his Ultimate, which can prove very tricky to acquire.

On top of this, the necessity to shoot through specific areas to deal extra damage, and the need to time jumps in order to make the most of his aerial attacks make him decently difficult to play and learn, as his unusual kit can prove very difficult to get used to.
In spite of all those flaws, however, it remains enough to clear the endgame content if you wish to master his kit.
In summary: Aalto is a subpar but viable DPS and Hybrid option, outclassed by stronger characters while still remaining usable if you play him well.

synergies.commentary: As a core component of all mono Aero teams, Ciaccona is the best partner for Main DPS Aalto, providing good on and off-field damage with a quick rotation, and further boosts to Aero DMG. She additionally allows Aalto to run the Windward Pilgrimage Echo set for maximum potential.
While Aalto is not optimal for Jiyan teams, he can serve as a viable replacement if any higher-priority teammates are already taken in other teams thanks to his 23% Aero DMG Amplify on Outro.
While Aalto is not optimal for Main DPS Iuno teams, he can serve as a viable replacement if any higher-priority teammates are already taken in other teams thanks to his 23% Aero DMG Amplify on Outro.

Another core member of the mono Aero teams with Ciaccona, Aero Rover can Amplify Aero DMG team-wide with their Signature weapon and also increase the maximum amount of Aero Erosion stacks enemies can have inflicted to further boost Ciaccona's off-field damage. Rhis makes them one of the best partners for DPS Aalto but also amazing as a general Aero DMG Amplifying Support.

One of the usual Healing Support options that can slot into any team. Super easy to use, provides amazing team-wide ATK% buffs and 15% DMG Amplify with one of the fastest rotations in the game. Enjoy.

Similar to Verina, a premium Healing Support option who can not only slot into any team, but also provide insane 12.5% Crit Rate, 25% Crit DMG, 25% ATK and 15% DMG Amplify buffs to your whole team. One of the best but also easy to use characters in the game.
